system.description:
You ensure the demise of your foe by turning misses into opportunities.

Prerequisite: Double Attack (Chosen Weapon)

Effect: Choose one weapon group or Exotic Weapon for which you have the Double Attack Feat. Whenever you miss a target with that weapon, you gain a +2 competence bonus on your next attack roll made before the end of your next turn against the missed target.

Special: You can select this Feat multiple times. Each time you select this Feat, it applies to a different weapon group or Exotic Weapon.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual
